sub: What to include, paragraph by paragraph

steps.title: Who you are
steps.tip: Use letterhead or a work email so it is easy to verify.

steps.title: What they did
points: The tools and skills they used
steps.tip: Facts first. Real tasks carry more weight than adjectives.

steps.title: How they worked
points: How they worked with the team
steps.tip: One short real example makes the whole letter believable.

steps.title: How they grew
points: Skills they built during the placement
Where they would do well next
steps.tip: Growth matters more than perfection for a first role.

steps.title: Sign off
steps.tip: Only write what you would happily repeat on the phone.

post_title: How to Write an Internship Reference Letter

captions.linkedin:
Your intern's reference can open their next door. Here's what to include, paragraph by paragraph.

1. Who you are: your role, how you know them, the dates
2. What they did: projects, tools, results you can stand behind
3. How they worked: reliability, teamwork, how they took feedback
4. How they grew: skills built, ownership, where they'd thrive next
5. Sign off: an honest recommendation and your contact details
